post.caption:
Friday, 4:40pm. The office manager is renaming scanned PDFs, retyping the same details into a second app and chasing one last signature.
Nobody is slacking. The right tools are just missing.
Here are five open source ones that take that work off a small office. Whisper turns recordings into text. Documenso collects signatures. n8n connects your apps. Invoice Ninja handles invoices and quotes. Paperless-ngx finds any document.
You can run all five yourself. Check each licence before using one for clients.
Comment "TOOLS" and I will send you the links.
Save this for the next time paperwork wins.
